# Workspace demo helper scripts

Reusable scripts backing the `workspace/demo/` skills. The demo skills call these instead of embedding
the runnable logic inline.

| Script | Purpose | Key parameters | Key output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steering-loop.ps1` | Single, non-breaking foreground countdown loop that prints one tick line per second for a fixed number of minutes. Backs the steering-and-queueing demo so a presenter can show Steering, queued messages, and Stop while a skill runs. Changes nothing on disk and is safe to cancel | `-Minutes` (how long to run) | one `[tick NNNN] loop running — Ns remaining` line per second, then a completion line |
| `chain-worker.ps1` | Simulated background work for the `workspace.demo.hooks-tour` PostToolUse chaining step: waits `-DelaySeconds`, then writes the completion marker `$env:TEMP\demo-chain.ready` containing a result string. Run in the background so the agent keeps working while it runs; the tour's PostToolUse hook detects the marker and chains the agent into a follow-up step | `-DelaySeconds` (default 5) | progress lines to the terminal, plus the marker file on completion |
| `hook-tour.ps1` | One generic hook handler backing the `workspace.demo.hooks-tour` demo for **every** event. The tour skill installs one temporary hook mapping all events to this script, passing the event name with `-Event`. Inert unless the tour is armed (a `demo-hooks-tour` marker folder in TEMP); while armed it logs every fire and produces one one-shot visible effect per event (deny on the sentinel for `PreToolUse`, a single resume for `Stop`, a chain-into-follow-up when the `chain-worker.ps1` marker is present for `PostToolUse`, an `additionalContext` banner for the rest) | `-Event` (the hook event name) | a hook JSON object on stdout appropriate to the event; appends to `$env:TEMP\demo-hooks-tour\events.log`; exit code `0` in all cases |
| `install-tour-hook.ps1` | Canonical home for the hooks-tour hook JSON — the tour skill calls this instead of embedding the file. By default it arms the tour (creates the `demo-hooks-tour` marker folder in TEMP) and writes `.github/hooks/workspace.demo.hooks-tour.json` mapping **all ten** lifecycle events to `hook-tour.ps1`. With `-Remove` it deletes the hook file and the marker folder (and any leftover `demo-chain.ready` marker), restoring the workspace | `-Remove` (tear down instead of install) | `INSTALLED=1` / `HOOK=` / `LOG=` on install; `REMOVED=1` / `HOOK=` on removal |
